epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup failure rate from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: The backend application must start successfully and respond to health checks on port 18080.

slices.title: Remediate backend application startup failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to resolve the root cause of the connection refused error, so that the application startup remediation is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed backend application container
When the system orchestrator requests the /health endpoint on port 18080
Then the application must return a successful HTTP response
And the application must remain in a running state without crashing.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce health check connection refused errors from 1 to 0
